speaker: Doctor

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue. I also have Appearance of pale skin, Presence of multiple pinpoint, red, nonblanching spots on extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP). The combination of fatigue, pallor, and specifically non-blanching pinpoint red spots (petechiae) on the extremities is highly suggestive of thrombocytopenia, likely due to ITP given the absence of other bleeding sources mentioned earlier.
